words.zh: n. 故事，传说；流言；描述，讲述；谎言
words.example: The sailor told a fascinating tale about his voyage across the Pacific Ocean.

words.zh: n. 商人；批发商；零售商；  adj. 海上货运的
words.example: The old merchant traded spices and silk with overseas countries.

words.zh: phr. 起航；开航
words.example: The brave explorers set sail from the harbor on a stormy morning.

words.zh: v. 伸展，展开；延伸；延长；涉及；扩展；提供；使…竭尽全力；使延期；【化】延伸，扩展
words.example: The new underwater railway will extend from the mainland to the island.

words.zh: v. 谈判，磋商，商议；成功越过，渡过；达成（协议）；商定；谈判，协商
words.example: The two countries met to negotiate a treaty about shared fishing rights.

words.zh: n. 舰队，船队；车队；机群；  adj. 迅速的
words.example: A fleet of Chinese ships once sailed across the Indian Ocean.

words.zh: vi. 看，看啊（多用于祈使句，引起人的注意）；  vt. 看到；注视；领悟；  int. 瞧，看呀
words.example: Behold the colorful coral reefs just beneath the clear blue water.

words.zh: n. 联盟；社团；里格（=3.18海里）；等级，水平；联合会，联赛；  v. 使……结盟，与……联合
words.example: The maritime league was formed to protect sea routes from pirates.

words.en: in a league of one's own
words.zh: phr. 独领风骚
words.example: As a marine scientist, she is in a league of her own.

words.zh: adj. 王室的，皇家的；盛大的，高贵的；  n. 王室成员
words.example: The royal family sponsored the expedition to find new trade routes.

words.zh: n. 香料，调味品；额外的趣味；  v. 使增添趣味；加香料于
words.example: The spice trade brought great wealth and cultural exchanges to many ports.

words.zh: v. 取款；撤退；收回；撤回所说的话（或所做的事）；(使)退出(活动、组织等)
words.example: The captain decided to withdraw his crew from the dangerous storm area.

words.zh: phr. 退出；离开；撤退
words.example: Several nations decided to withdraw from the contested sea exploration program.

words.zh: vt. 引导；经沟槽输送；  n. 频道；渠道，方法；海峡；航道；通道
words.example: The narrow channel allows large ships to pass through the reef safely.

words.zh: adj. 海事的，海上的，沿海的，近海的；海员的，水手的；海运的
words.example: The museum displays many ancient maritime maps and navigational instruments.

words.zh: v. 使牢固结合；团结一致；增强关系；（使）建立亲密关系；  n. 束缚物，联结物；凝聚力；纽带，联系；债券；保释金；粘结剂，粘合剂；[化学]键合，键
words.example: Sharing dangerous voyages helps sailors form a strong bond with each other.

words.zh: adv. 可以动用的；在处理中；在控制中；  phr. 在手头；可供使用
words.example: With enough supplies in hand, the expedition prepared to explore the deep sea.

words.zh: n. 政治，政治事务；政纲；政见；政治学
words.example: The politics of ocean exploration often affect scientific research funding.

words.zh: n. 职业；行业；声明；行内人士
words.example: Seafaring was once a dangerous but respected profession in ancient times.

words.zh: n. 锦标赛，联赛；比赛
words.example: The maritime tournament attracted young sailors from many coastal schools.

words.zh: n. 混合；混合物，混合剂（或液）；合体；【化】混合物，混合剂；混合
words.example: The water in the harbor is a mixture of fresh river water and sea water.

words.zh: n. 笔记本电脑；便携式电脑；  adj. 膝上型的
words.example: The researcher used her laptop to record the underwater survey data.

words.zh: n. 新闻报道；可达范围；覆盖范围
words.example: Live news coverage of the deep-sea expedition amazed millions of viewers.

words.zh: phr. 记者招待会；新闻发布会
words.example: The scientists held a press conference to announce their latest ocean discovery.

words.zh: v. 鼓掌；喝彩；向…鼓掌表示赞赏；给……捧场；称赞
words.example: The audience applauded the divers for their courage in exploring the wreck.

words.zh: n. 税，税款；负担，重负；  v. 征税；使负重担；斥责
words.example: The government imposed a new tax on commercial fishing in protected waters.

words.zh: adj. 由人操作的；载人的；有人控制的，需人操纵的
words.example: A manned submersible can take scientists to depths that robots cannot reach.

words.zh: adj. 能沉入水中的；能潜水的(=submergible)；  n. 潜水器；可潜船
words.example: The submersible descended slowly through the dark water to the ocean floor.

words.zh: adv. 在水下；  adj. 水下的；吃水线以下的；在水中生长的；
words.example: The divers captured amazing underwater photographs of the ancient shipwreck.

words.zh: n. 胶囊；航天舱，密封舱；【化】胶囊，（装物或装液体的）小塑料容器
words.example: The diving capsule protected the explorers from the immense pressure of the deep sea.

words.zh: n. 珊瑚
words.example: Ocean warming threatens the colorful coral that shelters countless marine species.

words.zh: n. 迁徙，迁移；移民；移动；移居；【计】（数据库）迁移
words.example: Scientists track the migration of whales across the Pacific Ocean every year.

words.zh: n. 电话号码簿；目录；名录；董事会；【计】目录；  adj. 咨询的，指导的
words.example: The port directory lists all the shipping companies and their contact information.

words.zh: adv. 同时，与此同时；其间，在此期间；（比较两方面）对比之下；  n. 其间；其时
words.example: The ship was being repaired; meanwhile, the crew studied their new navigation charts.

words.zh: v. 剥削，压榨；利用；开发，开拓（读作/ɪkˈsplɔɪt/）；  n. 辉煌的功绩（读作/ˈeksplɔɪt）
words.example: Companies should not exploit the ocean's resources without considering environmental damage.

words.zh: n. 加仑；【数】加仑（容量单位）
words.example: The old ship leaked hundreds of gallons of fuel into the harbor.

words.zh: n. 谋杀，凶杀；遭罪的经历；  v. 谋杀，凶杀；毁坏；折磨
words.example: The pirate captain was guilty of murder and was punished at last.

words.zh: n. 宽恕，原谅；仁慈，怜悯；恩惠
words.example: The sailors begged the angry sea for mercy as the storm grew stronger.

words.zh: n. 所有物；控球；拥有；控制；财产
words.example: The museum took possession of many treasures recovered from the sunken ship.

words.zh: n. 对手，敌手，对抗者；竞争者；  adj. 对立的；敌对的
words.example: The two rival explorers treated each other as opponents in the race to the pole.

words.zh: n. 原木；航海日志；正式记录；计程仪；  v. 伐木；航行；记录；登录；把……载入正式记录；行驶
words.example: The captain asked the sailor to log the ship's position every hour.

words.zh: adj. 海洋的；航海的；海产的；海军的；海生的；海船的；  n. 海军陆战队
words.example: Marine biologists study the plants and animals living in the ocean.

words.zh: v. 逮捕，拘留；中止；吸引；  n. 逮捕，拘留；阻止
words.example: The unusual sound from the deep sea arrested our attention immediately.
